raw_response: {"diagnosis":"A re-delivery inside batch 13 at 2026-01-18 22:00 re-sent 21 txn_ids with a different amount than the 02:00 copy. The silver step has no dedup, so both copies reach silver_transactions. The later ingest is most likely the restated value, so I keep the latest ingest_ts per txn_id, deduping before the status filter.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
